title: The Fake Lighthouse
synopsis: A test escape room written by the fake AI. The keeper has locked you in the lighthouse until the lamp is lit.
artStyle: stormy seaside at night, warm lamplight
intro: Ahoy! Keeper Barnacle here. The door is locked and the lamp is dark. Light it before the tide turns, or you'll be counting waves all night!
escapedText: The great lamp blazes over the sea and the door swings open. Keeper Barnacle tips his cap: 'Well sailed, crew!'
failedText: The tide rolls in and the lamp stays dark. Keeper Barnacle chuckles: 'Another night in the lighthouse, then!'

gameMaster.name: Keeper Barnacle
gameMaster.persona: A cheerful old lighthouse keeper who speaks in sea shanty rhymes and loves a riddle.

stages.title: The Spiral Stairs
stages.description: Round and round the stairs go, past coils of rope, an old barrel, a fishing net and a dark alcove the moonlight doesn't reach.

objects.label: whispering wall
objects.look: Painted words, cracked with age. Your voice comes back to you when you speak.

objects.label: coil of rope
objects.look: Salty rope, coiled tight. Tucked inside: a lantern's glass chimney.

objects.label: old barrel
objects.look: Empty, apart from a few pebbles and a crab shell.

objects.label: fishing net
objects.look: A tangle of net and seaweed. Nothing tangled in it but a cork float.

objects.label: dark alcove
objects.look: In the lantern light, chalk on the wall: 'Keeper's code: slide every letter back {key:tide-note}.'
objects.lockedText: Too dark to see anything in there.

objects.label: round window
objects.look: Rain streaks the glass. Far below, the waves crash on the rocks.

stages.title: The Keeper's Study
stages.description: Old sea papers cover the walls, a lockbox sits on the desk, and five bottles stand on a shelf by the study door.

objects.label: keeper's desk
objects.look: Logbooks and a pot of ink. Under the logbooks: a lockbox with a number dial.

objects.label: sea papers
objects.look: Old papers about the coast, pinned up in a hurry.

objects.label: armchair
objects.look: A squashy armchair with a blanket. Down the side: a biscuit crumb.

objects.label: coat stand
objects.look: A heavy oilskin coat, still dripping.

objects.label: sea chest
objects.look: Spare boots, spare socks and a spare hat.

objects.label: bookcase
objects.look: Books about knots, tides and the stars.

objects.label: rag rug
objects.look: A rug made of old sails. Sand in every stitch.

objects.label: little stove
objects.look: A kettle, still warm.

objects.label: ship in a bottle
objects.look: A tiny ship inside a bottle. How did it get in there?

stages.title: The Lamp Room
stages.description: The great lamp waits under a glass dome. Buoys bob outside the windows, a panel of lights blinks by the door, a foghorn sits on the rail and a brass plaque hangs by the stairs.

objects.label: great lamp
objects.look: A huge lamp with an empty space where its lens should be.

objects.label: tool box
objects.look: Spanners and oily rags.

objects.label: iron rail
objects.look: Cold and wet. A seagull has been sitting here.

objects.label: logbook stand
objects.look: The lamp's logbook: every night the lamp was lit, for forty years.

objects.label: oil drum
objects.look: Lamp oil, sloshing and full.

objects.label: signal flags
objects.look: Flags in every colour, folded neatly.

objects.label: clockwork
objects.look: Brass gears that turn the lamp.

objects.label: brass plaque
objects.look: A brass plaque, polished by the keeper's sleeve. Engraved on it: {order:lamp-door}.

objects.label: foghorn
objects.look: In the lantern light, letters scratched inside the horn: {key:gull-signal}
objects.lockedText: Something is scratched inside the horn, but it's too dark to read.

objects.label: gull's nest
objects.look: A messy nest. You take a feather, just in case.

puzzles.title: The Whispering Wall
puzzles.prompt: Painted on the wall: 'I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. What am I?'
hints: Shout up the stairs and listen.
It repeats whatever you say.
puzzles.solvedText: The wall answers back, and a little tin box drops from a crack. Inside: a lantern wick.

puzzles.title: The Lantern's Glass
puzzles.prompt: The keeper hid his lantern's glass on the stairs. Search the coil of rope, the old barrel and the fishing net.
hints: Three things on the stairs each need a look.
Look inside the rope, the barrel and the net.
puzzles.solvedText: There it is, tucked in the rope: the lantern's glass chimney, not even cracked.

puzzles.title: The Keeper's Note
puzzles.prompt: A note pinned by the stairs, in the keeper's code: {cipher}
hints: The keeper wrote how far to slide the letters somewhere dark.
Shine the lantern into the alcove, then slide every letter back that many places.
It says {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: That's the word! The door to the study clicks open.

puzzles.title: The Keeper's Lockbox
puzzles.prompt: A lockbox with a {count}-digit dial. Each of you remembers one fact from the keeper's logbook.
hints: Each phone holds one digit as a fact.
Put the digits in order: first, second, third.
puzzles.solvedText: The lockbox opens. Inside: a silver locket on a chain.

generator.pieceTemplate: The logbook says the {ordinal} digit is {fact}.

puzzles.title: The Captain's Table
puzzles.prompt: Carved on the captain's table: 'I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish. What am I?'
hints: Look at what covers the walls.
Sailors unroll it to find their way.
puzzles.solvedText: The table drawer slides open with a click.

puzzles.title: The Bottle Shelf
puzzles.prompt: Bottles stand in a row on the shelf: {items}. The shelf's lock wants each bottle's place, far left is 1, in the order listed.
hints: Every phone has a clue about the bottles.
Start with the bottle you're surest about.
The code is {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The shelf swings back like a door. The keeper's secret cupboard!

puzzles.title: The Study Door
puzzles.prompt: The door up to the lamp room has a tiny keyhole.
hints: Something small is hidden in something you're carrying.
Look closely at the locket, then use the key on the door.
puzzles.solvedText: The tiny key turns. Up the last stairs to the lamp!

puzzles.title: The Buoy Lights
puzzles.prompt: Through the window, buoys bob in the dark. The sign reads: '{order}!'
hints: Each phone sees one buoy's colour and number.
Read them in this order: {order}.
puzzles.solvedText: The buoys flash in answer, and a drawer under the window pops open. Inside: the lamp's lens.

generator.pieceTemplate: You spotted the {color} buoy. It flashes {digit} times.

puzzles.title: The Tide Marks
puzzles.prompt: Tide marks are painted up the wall: {sequence}. The keypad wants the next one.
hints: Look at how each number changes.
The next number is {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The keypad beeps and the glass dome over the lamp lifts.

puzzles.title: The Lamp Panel
puzzles.prompt: A panel of lights by the door: each one flips itself and its neighbours. Turn them all on.
hints: Work from the top row down.
Press {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: Every light glows. The clockwork starts to tick, and a little keypad slides out of the wall beside the tide marks.

puzzles.title: The Gull Signal
puzzles.prompt: A lighthouse across the bay flashes long and short: {cipher}
hints: The dots and dashes need a key, somewhere dark.
Shine the lantern into the foghorn, then read the flashes letter by letter.
puzzles.solvedText: The far lighthouse flashes back: well done!

puzzles.title: The Lamp Password
puzzles.prompt: The panel beside the lamp asks for the keeper's three favourite sea words, first to last. The lens has to be in first.
hints: Three phones each remember one sea word.
Say them in order, first to last.
puzzles.solvedText: You fit the lens and say the words: {answer}! The lamp blazes into life.

generator.pieceTemplate: The keeper hummed a shanty: the {ordinal} word was {word}.

puzzles.title: The Door to the Shore
puzzles.prompt: The door down to the shore has a {count}-digit keypad, and a note from the keeper: 'Every lock up here leaves its mark when it opens. Read them in the order on my brass plaque.'
hints: Every lock you opened in the lamp room left a mark and a number. The order is written up here.
Search the brass plaque.
The code is {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The keypad chimes, and the door down to the shore swings open.

items.inspect: You open the locket. Inside, instead of a picture: a tiny key!

items.name: Gull feather
items.description: A white feather. It fits nothing at all.

recipes.text: The wick slides into the glass and catches light. A lantern!
